relevance_note: The paper genotypes named members of the original Tangier disease kindred: 'the proband for Tangier disease was homozygous for a deletion of nucleotides 3283 and 3284 (TC) in exon 22' (gene printed as ABC1).
method_note: Built by a short Python script from my own reading; all values typed by hand, spans checked verbatim by script. Scope: 8 kindred members with individual data: VII-1 (proband) and VII-2 (affected sibling, homozygous), VI-2 and VI-3 (obligate heterozygote parents, RFLP heterozygous), VI-6 (RFLP heterozygous), and VI-4, VI-5, VI-1 (tested, normal RFLP pattern, 'apparently do not have the mutation'; in scope as tested-negative relatives, no variant rows). VI-7 and VI-8 are mentioned only as having no samples available and get no rows. Labels are the pedigree numbers the paper uses ('subject VII-1'); spans for labels use Table 1 row cells. Fig. 5 lane-to-subject mapping taken from the legend (E = VI-3, F = VI-2, G = VI-6, H = VI-4, I = VI-5, J = VI-1). Table 1 (lipoprotein values, patients as rows) values were not interpreted as low/high by me; only features the text states (marked reduction of HDL-C, apoA-I, apoA-II in VII-1/VII-2; ~50% reduction in HDL-C in VI-2/VI-3) are recorded; Table 1 values are given as detail. VI-6's lipids are only said to be 'similar to those of the obligate heterozygote parents', not recorded as a feature. Low LDL and high TG in Table 1 are not described in text, so not recorded. Kindred-level statements (enlarged lipid laden tonsils as a hallmark from the initial description; 'Minimal atherosclerosis is present in the original kindred') are not attributed to any individual. 'consanguinity at generations V and VI' is not explicitly tied to VII-1/VII-2's parents, so consanguinity left 'not reported'. Inheritance for the homozygous siblings: both parents are shown heterozygous; the enum has no biparental value and the parents' sexes are not stated, so 'inherited unspecified parent' was used. Year: only 'Contributed by ... August 4, 1999' is printed (not a publication year), so year is null. Study type 'other' (gene-structure paper plus a single-kindred genotyping). n_patients_reported not stated as a number. Prior report: the kindred and cell lines are said to be described in ref (1); ref (4) also used cells 'from this' kindred. Variant printed only as a nucleotide-number description (no c./p. notation, no transcript); protein consequence given in prose (frameshift starting at amino acid 1055, premature stop after amino acid 1084). Table 2 converted empty. No contradictions found.
